data.action: 右手用吸管轻搅放在桌上的奶茶，左手套指节碰对面同行者的蛋糕碟边，两人衣着完整。
data.description: 窗边奶茶卡座里，食蜂操祈穿蜂蜜黄开衫、象牙白高领上衣和茶灰百褶中裙，保留白色蛛网手套。她右手用吸管轻搅桌上的奶茶，左手指节轻碰对面同行者的蛋糕碟边，星瞳正盯着顶上的草莓。近处托盘把两只饮料杯与蛋糕分开，背后的弧形椅背接向服务台和糕点玻璃柜，窗外遮篷压住明亮街景。右侧窗光透亮奶茶与草莓，左上店灯照亮两人的脸与手套，托盘和杯底投下清楚的柔影——「本小姐才不是想要……只是帮你分担热量而已哦♪」
data.lighting: right-side window daylight through tea and strawberry; warm shop light from the upper left on both faces
data.location: 奶茶店窗边卡座，后方服务台与玻璃糕点柜可见
data.promptProse: Misaki sits on the left in her honey-yellow cardigan and web gloves, stirring the tea with her right hand while the knuckles of her left brush the cake plate. Her companion on the right has a straight black bob and a slate-blue cardigan, her face angled toward Misaki. Right-window light passes through the tea and strawberry, and a warm shop lamp fills both faces. The counter and pastry case recede behind the curved booth.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 奶茶店的午后加冕
data.animaCaption: Blonde Misaki in a honey cardigan stirs her tea with her right hand and touches the cake plate with her left gloved knuckles. Across the tray, her dark-bobbed companion in a slate cardigan sits beside the strawberry cake.
